name: hud_ui_net_game_setup_overlay_owner_on_deactivate
description: HudUiNetGameSetupOverlayOwner::OnDeactivate tears down the multiplayer setup overlay after leaving the state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41ad20 validates Sleep(1000), zSndSampleSet_DestroyByName("DIALOG"), a null-panel early return, and for a live panel: primary-buffer postprocess, SetEnabled(0), HudUiDialogController::BlitOwnedSurfaceToPrimary, zVideo::Dispatch_UnlockPrimarySurfaceState, scalar delete with flags 1, and m_panel clearing.

The native smoke patches the external providers and blit method to verify the null-panel and owned-panel paths, panel virtual SetEnabled/scalar-delete dispatch, and the owner vtable OnDeactivate slot.
